mainStory.purpose: Tell why HUANDENG exists, from the founder's own group-meeting experience, and show the features that answer each reason.
mainStory.audience: Researchers who make scientific presentations with AI, and people who may use or contribute to HUANDENG
mainStory.takeaway: Slides need a human story; HUANDENG lets you and an AI agent build a deck from that story, one page at a time, with every change recorded.

items.notes: Lab-meeting version, about eight minutes. I will skip the product tour and keep to the story: why I built this, one real slide, and how a change is made.
Short version: you have all seen slides that look like AI. My view is that the look comes from having no focus and no story. Even my own previous version of this talk had that problem.

Short version: this is a real result. The plot is drawn with Matplotlib from the data file, so if a value or a label changes, the agent changes the data or the script and redraws the figure, never the pixels.
Short version: try it on your next group-meeting deck. Tell the agent your story first, then ask for one change at a time.
